attribution: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin; Wohnlagen nach Adressen zum Berliner Mietspiegel 2026, WFS wohnlagenadr2026, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero – Version 2.0; transformed to EPSG:4326.

limitations: Wohnlage is the official Mietspiegel 2026 classification of an address's wider residential surroundings relative to Berlin. Indicators include land values, social-monitoring status, green volume and provision, distance to centres and rail, traffic noise, crime statistics, and Milieuschutz.
Wohnlage is not household income, purchasing power, commercial suitability, pedestrian footfall, café/shop/commercial rent, or a rent amount; no rent-table values are imported.

The Mietspiegel applies only to dwellings in its official scope (non-price-controlled flats in multi-family buildings, with listed exclusions). A class exists per address regardless of whether a particular dwelling is in scope.

Generalized Wohnlagenkarte map colours must never be used to infer an address class. The legally binding assignment is the official Straßenverzeichnis zum Mietspiegel 2026; this WFS is the provider's address dataset.
Validity is 2026-05-28 through 2028-05-28 per CKAN temporal metadata. Address-count shares are not population-weighted.
Provider records carry no edition field; the edition is pinned by the service name and this configuration. Raw hashes can differ between downloads because WFS timeStamp metadata changes.
